This file has a .txt extension and is therefore not in the supported
set (rs|py|js|ts). It is intentionally not Rust source. It exists so
that the strategy's walk can be observed to either silently filter it
out (acceptable, with no "skipped" entry) or report it as
`Skipped { reason: UnsupportedExtension }` (also acceptable). What is
NOT acceptable is treating it as a parse failure.
